hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'rm -rf /|rm -rf ~|drop\s+(table|database)|git push.*--force.*main|git reset --hard|shutdown|reboot|mkfs|dd if='; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Potentially destructive command detected: %s" }}' "$(echo "$cmd" | head -c 120)"; fi 2>/dev/null || true
